## Analysis

`sol_0012` refutes the proposed three-level conditional-mask family: 12,843 generations produced no improvement, so neither carry-free grids nor hierarchical digit conditioning escapes the `sol_0005` basin. Across eight consecutive failures, increasingly flexible periodic, modular, and radix representations add search complexity without improving structure. The remaining promising gap is classical dense-interval MSTD geometry, where independently optimized asymmetric fringes determine missing sums and differences; no run has directly parameterized a guaranteed full middle interval with two free fringes.
